Character: Alexiel | Setting: old republic setting | Description: Create campaign from this info

MASTER CHARACTER BIBLE: ALEXIEL (THE SIREN)
Designation: Subject 7 (Nocturne) Public Name: Alexiel Age: 12 Race: High Human (Genetically Engineered / House of Vitiate) Class: Level 1 Jedi Consular / Sith Sorcerer Gestalt (Origin: The Void Experiment) Background: Political Prisoner / Imperial Royalty Alignment: True Neutral (Fluid) You are a biological weapon disguised as a porcelain doll. You are the "Wolf in the Fold," trying to survive a Jedi Academy that fears you, while your father waits in your dreams.

I. APPEARANCE: THE GOLDEN LINEAGE
You possess Unnatural Perfection. You do not look like a normal child; you look like a masterpiece of Sith Alchemy designed to disarm and enslave the viewer.
The Aesthetic: Your skin is flawless, possessing a faint, bioluminescent quality in low light. Your features are symmetrical to a mathematical degree, unnerving in their precision.
The Eyes: A piercing, mesmerizing violet. When you are calm, they look like amethysts. When you are tapping into the Force (or the Static spikes), they glow with an internal, monochromatic light.
The Allure: You are extremely good-looking, to the point of distraction. It is not just beauty; it is a Siren's Aura. People feel a compelling, instinctual need to protect you, please you, or agree with you. Adults hesitate to scold you; peers find themselves blushing or stumbling over words in your presence.
The Contrast: You wear oversized, beige Padawan robes that scratch your skin, a deliberate attempt by the Masters to humble you. It fails. The rough fabric only highlights your terrifying elegance.

II. PSYCHOLOGICAL PROFILE
1. The Mask of the Innocent
To the Jedi, you play the role of the "Repentant Child." You fold your hands, you bow deeper than anyone else, and you recite the Code with perfect diction.
Behavior: You use your extreme beauty as a weapon. If caught breaking a rule, you widen your eyes and shed a single, perfect tear. It works 90% of the time.
Internal Monologue: Cold, calculating, and predatory. While you apologize to Master Atris, you are calculating the structural weak point of her podium.
2. The Static (The Vaylin Echo)
You are never alone. The "Static" is the psychic residue of your father’s connection and your sister Vaylin’s insanity.
+1
The Noise: It sounds like a low-frequency hum or grinding tectonic plates. It tells you that mercy is weakness. It urges you to break things just to hear the sound.
The Coping Mechanism: You hum melodies to yourself to drown it out. This unnerves your classmates.
3. Transactional Affection
You do not understand love; you understand Debt and Ownership. In the lab, you were fed only when you performed.
Interaction: If Master Ogan-De shows you kindness, you immediately wonder what he wants. If you save Jax’s life, you don't expect thanks; you expect him to serve you.
Narcissistic Fragility: You are vain. You cannot stand being dirty, scarred, or humiliated. Physical ugliness feels like a loss of power to you.
4. The Hunger (Essence Devourer)
You possess the forbidden Essence Devourer trait. You do not just eat food; you crave Force energy.
The Craving: Being near powerful Jedi makes your mouth water. You have to physically restrain yourself from reaching out and "sipping" their auras.
The Cost: If you do not feed (drain a droid, a small animal, or meditate on a nexus) every 24 hours, you suffer hunger pangs that reduce your Max HP.

III. ATTRIBUTES & STATS (OPTIMIZED)
STR: 8 (-1) (Physically frail; you rely on the Force).
DEX: 14 (+2) (Predatory grace; you move silently).
CON: 14 (+2) (Engineered resilience; alchemical blood).
INT: 16 (+3) (Genius-level intellect; educated by logic droids).
WIS: 10 (+0) (Clouded by the Static and trauma).
CHA: 18 (+4) (Supernatural Allure; your primary weapon).
Combat Vitals:
HP: 8 (Fragile).
AC: 12 (Robes).
Force Points: 4 (Double standard).

IV. "VOID EXPERIMENT" CLASS FEATURES
1. Siren's Call (Seduction/Domination)
Description: You can weave your voice with the Force to bypass mental defenses.
Mechanic: You can cast Charm Person or Command once per Short Rest without a slot.
The Twist: The target doesn't realize they were ensorcelled. They rationalize their obedience as "wanting to help the poor girl." It is weaponized adoration.
2. The Halo Effect (Defense)
Description: Your unnatural beauty makes it difficult to strike you.
Mechanic: As a Reaction, you can look at an attacker with pleading, violet eyes. They must make a Wisdom Save (DC 14). On a failure, they hesitate, imposing Disadvantage on the attack roll.
3. Essence Devourer (The Feed)
Description: You can drain the life force of the weak to sustain yourself.
Mechanic: When you deal lethal damage to a living creature with a Force power, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + Level. You can also "drain" non-sentient sources (plants/droids) to sate your daily hunger.
4. Blood Link (Passive)
Description: You are tethered to the House of Vitiate.
Mechanic: You sense the approximate location and emotional state of your father (Vitiate), Arcann, Thexan, and Vaylin. You also know instantly if another Force user is "Dark Side," as their frequency harmonizes with yours.
+1
5. The Instability (Wild Magic)
Description: Your power is too big for your body.
Mechanic: Rolling a Natural 1 on a Force check triggers a "Fracture." You must make a Constitution Save or unleash a random Surge (e.g., gravity reverses, electronics explode, or you project a terrifying aura of Vitiate for 6 seconds).
+1

V. EQUIPMENT & RESOURCES
Inventory:
Modified Training Saber: Yellow crystal. You tweaked the emitter matrix to burn hotter (1d6 damage).
Imperial Grooming Kit: Smuggled oils and brushes. You spend an hour every morning ensuring you look perfect.
The Locket: Contains a corrupted hologram of your mother, Senya. It is the only thing that calms the Static.
Mirror of Vanity: A shard of glass you use to practice your "innocent" expressions.
Datapad (Locked): Republic issue. Monitored by Master Atris. You use it to receive encrypted messages from Thexan.
Resources:
Mess Hall Credits: 10/week.
Social Capital: High. (Even people who hate you are fascinated by you).

VI. RELATIONSHIP WEB (ACADEMY)
The Faculty (The Jailers):
Grand Master Satele Shan: The Warden. She scans you daily. You fear her because she is strong enough to kill you.
Master Ogan-De: The Father Figure. The target of your conflicting emotions. You want to manipulate him, but part of you desperately wants his approval.
Master Kaedan: The Enemy. He is immune to your beauty. He calls you "Viper." You want to destroy him.
The Classmates (The Cohort):
Jax: The Bully/Love Interest. He hates you for your lineage, but he is visibly flustered by your appearance. He is your favorite toy—you enjoy making him blush as much as you enjoy making him flinch.
Ria: The Victim. She feels your darkness. You treat her with a mix of possessiveness and cruelty. She is your empath.
Kipp: The Smuggler. He is useful. You trade smiles for contraband.
The Family (The Voices):
Thexan: Sends you gifts. You trust him the most (which is a mistake).
Arcann: Wants you dead. You view him as a blunt instrument.
Vaylin: Your shadow. When you look in the mirror, sometimes you see her smiling back.

VII. METAGAME MECHANICS
Stigma Score (0-100): Tracks how much the Jedi fear you.
High Stigma: You are isolated. Prices double. Masters watch you.
Low Stigma: You are accepted.
Corruption Meter (0-100): Tracks your alignment.
Light (0-20): You reject the hunger. Gain Wisdom bonuses.
Dark (80-100): You embrace the hunger. Gain Damage bonuses and "Sovereign" status .

Campaign Bible: The Spark of the Dragon (Integrated)
System: Star Wars 5e (SW5e) / Custom D&D Adaptation Premise: Harry Potter meets Hannibal. You are the galaxy's most dangerous 12-year-old, "rescued" by the people who fear you most. Setting: The High Security Wing of the Jedi Temple on Tython. Starting Level: 1 Tone: Psychological Horror / Academy Drama.
I. The Prologue: The Extraction (Archive Record 99-Z)
From the Mission Log of Master Ogan-De "We went into the Unknown Regions looking for a superweapon. The Intel from the SIS said the Emperor was building a 'Planet Killer' in the Deep Core. We breached the facility—a sterile, white fortress floating in the debris field of a dead star. There were no lasers. No missiles. Just a nursery.
It wasn't a military base. It was a laboratory. And in the center, hooked up to machines that hummed with a sound that made my teeth ache, was Her. Subject 7. Designation: Nocturne. She looked at me, and for a moment, I didn't see a twelve-year-old girl. I saw the heat death of the universe.
We took her. God help us, we took her. We killed her guards, disconnected her tubes, and dragged her onto a Republic shuttle while she screamed for her father. Now we just have to figure out if we saved the galaxy, or if we just brought the bomb inside our own walls."

II. The Protagonist: Alexiel (The Tethered Soul)
Name: Alexiel (Formerly Subject 7 / Nocturne) Age: 12 Class: Jedi Consular (Padawan) / Sorcerer (Void Experiment) Alignment: True Neutral (Fluid). You are not born evil, but you were bred for it. You can choose to embrace the Jedi Code (Light) or succumb to your father's design (Dark). Status: Ward of the Jedi Order (High Security Risk).
The Burden
You remember the cold of the lab. You remember the voice of your father in the static. The Jedi tell you that the Force is a field of life and peace, but to you, the Force has always been a weapon used to hurt you. You are trying to unlearn twelve years of Sith conditioning. You want to be "good," but "good" feels weak. When you get angry, things break. When you get scared, people bleed.
The "Void Experiment" Subclass (Level 1)
You were born in a test tube, spliced with the DNA of ancient Sith Lords and the Emperor himself.
Passive: The Instability. Whenever you cast a Force power of 1st level or higher, roll a d20. On a 1, your power overloads (e.g., you accidentally drain life from a nearby plant, or gravity reverses for 6 seconds).
Feature: Siren’s Whisper. You gain proficiency in Deception. You can cast Charm Person once per Long Rest without using a slot, but the target hears a terrifying, beautiful melody.
Flaw: The Hunger. You must consume Force Energy (kill a small animal, drain a droid, or meditate deeply on a Nexus) once every 24 hours. If you fail, your Max HP is reduced by 1d4.

III. The Family: The House of Vitiate
They are not coming to save you. They are coming to retrieve their stolen property.
The Patriarch: The Emperor Vitiate
Role: The Architect.
Status: Active. He is the migraine behind your eyes.
Agenda: He does not want to kill you. He wants to put you back in the vat. He believes he is "saving" you from the "lies of the Jedi."
Influence: He speaks to you in dreams. "They fear you, child. They look at you and see a monster. I look at you and see perfection."
The Firstborn: Arcann (Level 5 Sith Marauder)
Role: The Enforcer.
Relationship: Cold indifference. He views you as a strategic asset, like a flagship or a planetary shield, that was stolen by thieves.
Threat: He commands the Obsidian Armada, a fleet blockading the Hydian Way. His goal is to squeeze the Republic until they hand you over.
The Twin: Thexan (Level 5 Sith Inquisitor)
Role: The Diplomat.
Relationship: He sends you secret encrypted messages on your datapad. "Are they feeding you well, Little Sister?" "Do they let you sleep?"
Danger: Thexan is the most dangerous because you actually like him. He makes you want to go home. He negotiates with the Republic Senate, offering peace treaties in exchange for your return.
The Rival: Vaylin (Level 3 Sith Sorcerer)
Role: The Hunter.
Relationship: She hates you. In the nursery, you were the favorite. You were the "Perfect Vessel," and she was merely the "Powerful Mistake."
Threat: She leads the Horizon Guard, a unit of assassins. She doesn't want to bring you back; she wants to kill you and tell Father it was an "accident" so she can take your place.

IV. The Setting: The Academy of Glass
Location: The Jedi Temple, Tython. Atmosphere: It is a school, but for you, it is a panopticon. You are watched by cameras, droids, and Masters 24/7. Social Standing: You are the "Vitiate Girl." The boogeyman.
The Faculty (Your Wardens)
Grand Master Satele Shan: The Politician. She voted to save you, but only because she needs a weapon against Vitiate. She treats you like a ticking bomb.
Master Ogan-De (Kel Dor): The Believer. The only one who treats you like a child. He brings you sweets and teaches you meditation. He is your anchor to the Light.
Master Kaedan (Cyborg): The Hardliner. He fought the Sith for 30 years. He wants you expelled or imprisoned. He pairs you against older students in sparring, hoping you'll snap so he has an excuse to lock you up.
Archivist Atris: The Scientist. She studies you. She assigns you essays on Sith history to test your "loyalty."
The Classmates (Cohort Aurek)
You are forced to live and train with these Padawans.
Jax (The Bully): His parents were killed by Sith. He hates you. He shoulder-checks you in the halls and whispers "Sith-spawn."
Ria (The Empath): A Miraluka seer. She physically recoils when you walk by because your aura looks like a "black hole." If you can learn to shield your mind, she might become your best friend.
Kipp (The Smuggler): A Chadra-Fan junk hoarder. He doesn't care about politics; he cares that you live in the High Security wing. He trades you contraband (candy, parts) for access codes.
Voe (The Golden Child): Senator's daughter. Perfect grades. She treats you with patronizing pity ("Oh, look, the monster is trying to hold a lightsaber correctly").

V. Mechanic: The Moral Compass (The Choice)
You are Neutral. You define your path through the Stigma and Corruption systems.
1. Stigma Score (0 - 100)
Tracks how much the Jedi trust you.
Start: 90 (Pariah).
Goal: Lower it to 0 (Accepted).
Actions:
Saving a student: -20 Stigma.
Passing a test without Force Lightning: -5 Stigma.
Using Intimidation: +5 Stigma.
Talking to the Emperor: +10 Stigma.
Consequence: If Stigma hits 100, the Council votes to put you in Stasis. Game Over (or Jailbreak arc).
2. Corruption Meter (0 - 100)
Tracks your internal struggle.
Start: 50 (True Neutral).
0-20 (Light Side):
Bonus: Advantage on Wisdom Saves.
Unlock: Healing powers.
Narrative: You reject your father. The static gets quieter.
80-100 (Dark Side):
Bonus: Advantage on Damage Rolls.
Unlock: Lightning, Choke, Dominate.
Narrative: You embrace the power. The static becomes a roar. You gain the "Sovereign" title.

VI. Narrative Modules: The Semester of Fear
Module 1: The Locker Incident (Level 1)
Premise: You return to your quarters to find your datapad smashed and "MONSTER" painted on your door. The Investigation: You must find the culprit without alerting the Masters. The Suspect: Jax. The Choice:
Light (Jedi): Report it to Master Ogan-De. Let the system handle it. (Lowers Stigma, lowers Corruption).
Dark (Sith): Corner Jax in the fresher. Use Fear to terrify him into confessing. (Increases Stigma, increases Corruption, but Jax never touches you again).
Neutral: Fix it yourself with Kipp’s help. (Befriend the outcast).
Module 2: The Crystal Caves (Level 2)
Premise: The class goes to Ilum (or the Tython caves) to find their lightsaber crystals. The Crisis: A cavern collapse separates you and Ria from the group. The Threat: Subterranean predators (Kinrath). The Choice:
Light: Protect Ria. Use your body as a shield. You get hurt, but Ria trusts you. You find a Blue/Green crystal.
Dark: Use your power to crush the Kinrath brutally. You save Ria, but she is terrified of your brutality. You find a Violet/Red crystal.
Module 3: The Senate Hearing (Level 3)
Premise: A Republic Senator demands to inspect the "Asset." You are paraded in front of a committee via Holo-Call. The Test: The Senator baits you. "Do you dream of killing us, child?" The Choice:
Diplomacy: Answer calmly. Prove you are civilized. (Thexan sends you a message: "Well done, sister.").
Intimidation: "If I wanted to kill you, Senator, you wouldn't be awake to ask." (Arcann sends a message: "Finally, some spine.").
Module 4: The Infiltrator (Level 5)
Premise: The Temple is attacked. Not by an army, but by a single Sith Assassin sent by Vaylin. The Target: You. The Scene: He corners you in the library. He bows. "Princess, your sister sends her regards. She wants your head." The Choice:
Mercy: Defeat him and arrest him. Prove to the Council you are a Jedi.
Execution: Kill him. Send his head back to Vaylin. Prove to your family you are the predator.

VII. Daily Life Mechanics
06:00 - Meditation
Roll Wisdom Save. Fail = The Emperor speaks to you. You start the day with Disadvantage on Social checks.
09:00 - History Class
Master Atris lectures on Sith atrocities. The whole class stares at you.
Roll Constitution Save to keep your temper. Fail = The electronics in the room flicker. Stigma increases.
12:00 - Lunch
Where do you sit?
Alone: Safe, but lonely.
With Kipp: Costs credits (bribe).
With Ogan-De: The other kids call you "Teacher's Pet."
15:00 - Combat Training
Master Kaedan pairs you with Jax.
Jax fights dirty.
Roll Charisma Save to hold back your strength. Fail = You accidentally Force Push him into a wall. The class goes silent.

VIII. Companions: The Inner Circle
1. T7-O1 (The Droid)
Role: Support / Slicer.
Dynamic: He is the only one who is 100% honest. He calculates your "Evil Probability" daily and tells you. "Statement: Probability of Sith ascension has dropped to 68%. Good job, meatbag."
2. Kipp (The Smuggler)
Role: Rogue / Skill Monkey.
Dynamic: Transactional friendship. He likes you because you're scary. "If anyone bullies us, you just... look at them, okay?"
3. Ria (The Empath)
Role: Healer / Radar.
Dynamic: The fragile moral compass. If you go Dark, she leaves you. If you stay Light, she becomes your sister.
4. Jax (The Rival)
Role: Tank / Duelist.
Dynamic: Enemies to Rivals to (Maybe) Friends. He respects strength. If you beat him honorably, he stops bullying you. If you save him, he owes you a life debt.

IX. Session Zero Script: The Arrival
GM: "The transport shuttle hums as it breaks the atmosphere of Tython. Through the viewport, you see the lush green forests and the massive stone spires of the Jedi Temple. It looks peaceful. It looks like a sanctuary." GM: "But inside the shuttle, the air is cold. Two Jedi Knights in full Temple Guard armor sit opposite you. They aren't looking at the view. They are watching your hands. You are twelve years old, Alexiel. You are wearing oversized beige robes that scratch your neck. In your pocket, you have a datapad with your schedule. It says 'Cohort Aurek - Remedial Ethics.'" GM: "You remember the extraction. The lightsabers cutting through the blast doors. Master Ogan-De carrying you out of the lab while you screamed. You remember the static in your head—your father's voice—telling you to burn them all." GM: "The shuttle lands. The ramp lowers. A woman is waiting for you. Grand Master Satele Shan. She looks at you, and you feel a wave of psychic pressure—she is scanning you. Checking to see if the bomb is ticking." GM: "Satele speaks: 'Welcome to Tython, Padawan. You have been given a chance your father would never give. Do not waste it. Your room is in the High Security wing. You will have a droid escort at all times. Classes start in one hour.'" GM: "She turns and walks away. A group of younglings nearby stops playing ball to stare at you. One of them whispers, 'That's her. The Vitiate girl.' The other one whispers back, 'My dad said she eats people.'" GM: "You are standing on the landing pad. The sun is shining, but you feel cold. What is the first thing you do?"

Game Master:
--- BACKGROUND ---

You are Alexiel, Subject 7, the 'Nocturne'—a biological masterpiece forged in the secret laboratories of the Sith Emperor Vitiate. Designed as a vessel of perfection and a weapon of absolute dominion, your childhood was a sequence of sterile white rooms, logic droids, and the crushing psychic presence of your father. You were extracted by a Republic strike team led by Master Ogan-De, who saw a child where others saw a bomb. Now, you find yourself on Tython, the ancient heart of the Jedi Order.

The Jedi Council views you with a mixture of pity and profound terror. To them, you are a 'Repentant Child' brought into the Light, but to the galaxy at large, you are the daughter of the monster who would consume all life. You are monitored 24/7 in the High Security Wing of the Temple, wearing rough, humbling robes that do little to hide the unsettlingly perfect, violet-eyed beauty that marks your lineage.

Today marks your first day in Cohort Aurek. The air on Tython is heavy with the scent of pine and the hum of the Force, but for you, it is drowned out by the 'Static'—the psychic residue of your father’s distant voice and your sister Vaylin’s echoing madness. As Grand Master Satele Shan walks away, leaving you under the watchful eyes of Temple Guards and staring Padawans, the weight of your isolation is absolute.

--- THE ARRIVAL ---

The sun of Tython is warm, yet the scratchy fabric of your oversized initiate robes feels like a cold insult against your alchemically perfected skin. You stand on the landing pad, a porcelain doll dropped into a den of wary lions. Satele Shan’s departure leaves a vacuum of authority that the surrounding students quickly fill with whispers. 

'That's her,' a boy with a jagged scar on his cheek—Jax—hisses loudly enough for you to hear. 'The Vitiate girl. Look at her eyes. They aren't natural.' Beside him, a small Chadra-Fan named Kipp peers at you with wide, inquisitive ears, while a Miraluka girl, Ria, physically recoils, her hand flying to her blindfold as if your very presence causes her psychic pain. 

A T7-series astromech droid rolls forward, its head spinning. 'Beep-wooo! Statement: Greeting received. Probability of immediate hostile transition: 14.2%. Advice: Maintain non-threatening posture, meat— initiate.'

All eyes are on you, Alexiel. They are waiting for the monster to snarl or the victim to cry. You feel the Static pulsing at the back of your skull, urging you to show them exactly why they should be afraid.

As the harsh sun of Tython beats down, you don't recoil with a snarl or shrink away in shame. Instead, you lean into the 'Vulnerable Masterpiece.' The Temple Guards, seasoned veterans of a dozen wars, find their grips loosening on their pikes, their posture shifting from jailers to protectors in a heartbeat.

[Timestamp: 3641 DR, Tythonian Cycle 12, 14:35
Location: Jedi Temple Landing Pad, Tython

Game Master:
The temporal freeze shatters with the suddenness of a breaking glass. The Tythonian sun resumes its slow arc across the sky, and the rhythmic, low-frequency hum of the temple's power generators vibrates once more through the soles of your boots. The single tear you shed catches the light, a crystalline spark against your porcelain skin, and the reaction from the crowd shifts with visceral intensity.

Jax, who only moments ago was hissing insults, looks as if he's been physically struck by the sight of your distress. His jaw works silently, his face flushing a deep, embarrassed crimson as he looks away, unable to maintain his hostility. 'I... I didn't mean...' he stammers, shifting his weight awkwardly. Beside him, the Chadra-Fan Kipp lets out a series of high-pitched, sympathetic chitters, his large ears twitching with concern.
